title: Two-factor authentication
sensitiveRecoveryHelp: Cannot use your authenticator? Sign out to reset it with a recovery code. This operation will be cancelled.
recoveryHelp: These codes are shown only once. Store them safely to reset and bind a new authenticator if yours is lost.
enabledHelp: Login requires two-factor verification. Contact a user administrator if you lose your authenticator and recovery codes.
resetConfirm: Reset this user’s authenticator? Existing sessions and recovery codes will become invalid.
manualSetup: Cannot scan? Enter the key manually
copyFailed: Copy failed. Select and save the recovery codes manually.
continueFailed: Unable to continue. Try again; your recovery codes are still available here.
copySecretFailed: Copy failed. Select and copy the setup key manually.
recoveryResetHelp: Your current authenticator, recovery codes and sessions will become invalid. Bind a new authenticator to continue.
loginExpired: Verification expired. Return to login and try again.
testSuccess: Test passed. Your authenticator is working.

errors.credential: The verification credential is invalid or expired. Try again.
errors.invalidCode: The code is invalid or already used. Enter a new code.
errors.rateLimited: Too many verification attempts. Try again later.
errors.unavailable: Two-factor verification is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
